lines.zh: 我浮在地面之上，走得很轻。
lines.en: I float above the ground, walking light.

lines.zh: 一只手抬起，屏障就开了。
lines.en: One hand raised, and the barrier opens.
I circle you without a sound.

lines.zh: 这片天，我走得比地面舒服。
lines.en: This sky is easier to walk than the ground.
I watch you while I walk. Don't misunderstand.
The air parts before me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把距离缩小。
lines.en: Step by step, I close the distance.

lines.zh: 我的步伐，像在量你的位置。
lines.en: My steps measure where you stand.
I sink a little, then float up again.

lines.zh: 我走的每一步都有目的。
lines.en: Every step I take has a purpose.

lines.zh: 风把我的衣角吹得很平。
lines.en: The wind presses my clothes flat.
I don't like walking behind anyone.
I stand still, fingers barely moving.
Energy thickens into a sheet before my palm.
I wait for you to come closer.

lines.zh: 屏障张开，你的气弹弹回去。
lines.en: My barrier opens, and your blast goes back.
It looks like I'm only standing.
Watch my right hand.
I count footsteps on the wind.
A barrier slowly forms behind me.
I smile, faintly.
Such quiet is rare.
My shadow stands far from my feet.
I'm counting your steps.
My shoulders are loose. My hands are not.
Being watched doesn't bother me.
Your eyes keep darting.
You must have miscalculated something.
I don't like being sized up.
Where you stand, I can pinch you.
Good enough that one reach covers it.

lines.zh: 你身上有股急躁的味道。
lines.en: You carry a smell of impatience.
Don't rush to strike.

lines.zh: 我说话的时候，你别插嘴。
lines.en: When I speak, don't interrupt.
Your sword is dipping.

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候，我也在看你。
lines.en: While you watch me, I watch you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸暴露了你的慌。
lines.en: Your breathing betrays your panic.
I know you'll strike first.
Stand three more seconds. Don't move.
Floating, my barrier takes the front.
Listen. The wind stopped.
You shouldn't have let me speak first.
When I raise my hand, don't move.
You have only one choice.
You broke through my energy.
I slid half a step and set myself.
This wound won't affect my judgment.
You're faster than I expected.
My barrier has a crack.
It hurts, but I can bear it.

lines.zh: 你看清了我的一次失误。
lines.en: You've seen one of my mistakes.
I'll make up for this blow.
My bones are creaking, and my teeth too.
You got lucky.
You hold something up. What do you want in trade?
Put it down. I don't need it.
You're stalling.
I don't eat things like that.
That faint sweetness in your hand.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我在看你怎么演。
lines.en: I'm not hungry. I'm watching your performance.
Hand it over, and I'll take it.
You've held it up too long.
This trick is old.
Are you waiting for me to say yes?

lines.zh: 你撞过来，屏障先接住了。
lines.en: You charged, and the barrier caught you first.
I was pushed back half a step.
Don't touch my barrier.

lines.zh: 你的手贴在我的屏障上。
lines.en: Your hand is pressed to my barrier.
I raised my hand and you backed off.
My barrier took that impact.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，风响了一声。
lines.en: We collided, and the wind rang.
You stunned your own feet with that.
I slid away like water.
Touch me and your hand goes numb.

lines.zh: 巴特那伙人，不适合谈这个。
lines.en: Barter's crew isn't right for such talk.
These hands only hold a barrier.
Don't look at me that way.
In this world, I trust only myself.
You've changed the subject too abruptly.
Power is more reliable than tenderness.
My barrier won't embrace anyone.

lines.zh: 你若想活，就别说这种话。
lines.en: If you want to live, don't say such things.
We'll talk after this fight.
I've always been alone.
This iron box won't hold much.

lines.zh: 我用指尖挑起那枚碎片。
lines.en: I flick the shard up with a fingertip.
You dropped it? Taking it costs me nothing.
This shard reflects light. Annoying.
I tuck it into my sleeve.
What it is doesn't matter to me.
A flick of my hand lifts it.
Leave it. I don't need it.
It's heavier than it looks.
I'll take it. Don't say a word.
I've already calculated your position.
Don't move. Stay just like that.
I decide when this fight begins.

lines.zh: 我的屏障从你身后升起。
lines.en: My barrier rises behind you.
I've sealed your way back.
Your position is in my palm.
You came too close.
Now it's my turn to strike.

lines.zh: 你的重心压在前脚掌上。
lines.en: Your weight sits on the ball of your foot.
I've seen your opening.
You won't dodge in time.
Begin. Enough talk.
My hand has been on your side all along.
The instant you turned was enough.
I dislike dragging things out.
This is where it ends.
You run left, I block the left.
Circle all you like. I'll circle with you.
My barrier follows you.
You're not slow.
But you've picked the wrong direction.
I see where you plant your feet.
Your breathing grows heavier.
I've sealed two sides of this clearing.
I sealed the left. Go right.
My hand hasn't come down once.

lines.zh: 你回头看我的时候，我在看别处。
lines.en: When you look back, I'm looking elsewhere.
Actually, I've been watching you all along.
You stepped into my energy.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，你也不敢过。
lines.en: I step aside, and still you won't pass.

lines.zh: 你停下，我的屏障就成型。
lines.en: You stop, and my barrier sets.
You're beginning to understand.
I don't need to chase.
You'll walk in on your own.
One palm strike, energy bursting from the heel of my hand.
You're shoved so you can't stand straight.
The barriers close and pinch you.
This one isn't heavy.
You raised a guard, and your hand bone cracked.
My energy runs along your armor.

lines.zh: 你退了，正好进我的位置。
lines.en: You backed right into my spot.
One palm push and you slide along the ground.
Your weapon flew off.
This palm comes from the side.
Your knee buckled.
I withdraw my hand and step back into place.

lines.zh: 你的脚被气缠住，慢了下来。
lines.en: Energy wraps your feet and slows you.
I strike the back of your knee.
This one comes down from above.
The blow spins you halfway around.
Energy gathers into a sheet in the air.

lines.zh: 我从那道缝隙里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of that seam.
The ground doesn't react. I'm too light.
When you look up, I'm already here.
My hand arrives before I do.
This clearing is mine.
No sound, only energy.
I descend slowly.
The wind parts on both sides.
I'm not here to chat.
You should feel honored.
I stand here, waiting for you to move first.
The barrier unfolds behind me.
I glance at you.
This step took me a long time.
I've cut off one of your routes.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音，几乎听不见。
lines.en: The sound of my landing is almost nothing.

lines.zh: 屏障在我面前铺开，像一面墙。
lines.en: The barrier spreads before me like a wall.
Fire coils around my aura, hot.

lines.zh: 落地而已，我本来就在浮。
lines.en: Just a landing. I was floating anyway.
My energy thins a little in water.

lines.zh: 我的气功屏障，被炸开了。
lines.en: My ki barrier burst open.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过缝隙，扎进来。
lines.en: An arrow slipped through a gap and found me.

lines.zh: 咒语贴在我屏障上，吱吱响。
lines.en: The spell hisses against my barrier.
Even energy starves. I can't last long.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我半边身子发麻。
lines.en: Lightning fell and half my body went numb.
The void swallows my energy. It's empty here.
